name: Bloomtill
summary: A till and back office for a small shop with two branches, shown with a Lahore florist
about: A point of sale and back office for a florist with shops in Gulberg and DHA. Ring up stems, bouquets, plants and gifts, take cash with change or card, hold a sale for later, and watch the receipt print out of the till while petals burst. Stock carries fresh-until dates, moves between shops and can be written off; pre-orders, customers with important dates, cash drawers and reports sit alongside.
how: Pick a shop at the top (Gulberg, DHA or Both); every page follows it.
On the Till, tap flowers to add them, change quantities, add a discount and a customer.
Choose cash, card or transfer; for cash enter the amount received to see the change, then Charge: the receipt prints and stock drops at that shop.
Hold a sale to serve someone else and resume it later from Held sales.
On Stock, receive deliveries with a fresh-until date, transfer between shops and write off wilted stems.
Move pre-orders from Confirmed to Delivered, and count each cash drawer at closing to see if it is over or short.
Switch Reports between 7D, 30D and 12M; Settings edits the receipt footer and resets the demo data.
